title: 價牌沒動，供應方式先動

lines.text: 開頭提到的自家工廠，正是供應方式的轉變。NPR 報導，

data.prompt: Medium shot at a food receiving dock, one generic clerk checks plain sausage cartons on a delivery trolley, attentive face, soft grey doorway light

lines.text: 早期供應商是 Hebrew National；到了二〇〇八年，

data.prompt: Medium shot in a food factory in 2008, one generic production worker checks a tray of plain sausages beside a simple conveyor, focused face, soft ceiling light

lines.text: Costco 開始經營自己的熱狗工廠，降低供應鏈成本。

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a purchasing desk, one generic buyer unfolds a blank quotation sheet beside a plain food carton, thoughtful expression, mild desk light

lines.text: 這一步改變了問題的位置。原來是拿著供應商的報價，

data.prompt: Wide shot in a food factory, one generic supervisor inspects a simple conveyor carrying plain sausage trays, concentrated face, soft overhead light

lines.text: 回頭想套餐該賣多少；現在，Costco 得自己處理生產這一端。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a food preparation station, one generic worker lifts a plain ingredient sack beside a small processing machine, focused expression, diffuse ceiling light

lines.text: 工廠也不是免費的。它需要設備、原料和人手，

data.prompt: Close-up at a factory control station, one generic technician adjusts an unmarked control dial beside a tray of sausages, attentive face, mild lamp light

lines.text: 所以「自己做」不等於成本消失，而是把更多能調整的環節放回自己手上。

data.prompt: Medium shot at an archive desk, one generic researcher opens a blank report folder beside a small hot dog tray photograph with no text, curious expression, soft window light

lines.text: 為什麼連一份熱狗都要這麼費心？這件事後來有了一段很有名的回憶。

data.subtitle: Jelinek 事後回憶・原對話日期未知
data.tag: NPR 2024 引述 Jelinek 2018 回憶

lines.text: NPR 引述前執行長 Craig Jelinek 二〇一八年的回憶：

data.prompt: Medium close-up in an archive study, one generic researcher raises a blank report page beside a plain food tray, surprised expression, soft desk-lamp light

lines.text: 他曾提出漲價問題，Sinegal 甚至放話，要是把熱狗漲價，

data.prompt: Close-up at the archive desk, one generic reader rests a finger beside a blank paragraph on the page, thoughtful face, mild window light

lines.text: 這段事後回憶裡，拒絕改價並沒有解決成本問題；

data.prompt: Medium shot at a planning bench, one generic analyst places a plain price stand beside an ingredient tray, puzzled expression, soft overhead light

lines.text: 它把難題留給經營者：價錢先留著，其他環節要怎麼改？

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a reading desk, one generic analyst turns a blank report page beside a plain factory folder, attentive expression, mild table-lamp light

lines.text: Fox Business 也轉述他說，自製之後已有合理回報。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a study desk, one generic researcher separates a closed archive folder from an empty ledger, careful expression, soft window light

lines.text: 這可以補上歷史的一角，卻不是今天每份熱狗的損益表。每賣一份到底剩多少，

data.prompt: Wide shot from the edge of a warehouse food court, one generic customer carries a hot dog tray toward a table overlooking store shelves, curious face, diffuse skylight

lines.text: 這些公開資料沒有交出答案。
但我們還有更大的問題沒解開：

data.prompt: Medium shot beside a warehouse dining table, one generic member sets a plain hot dog tray next to a loaded shopping trolley, thoughtful expression, soft ceiling light

lines.text: 就算熱狗成本有辦法管理，整間賣場為什麼要把低價看得這麼重？
